title: Werner® Announces Quarterly Dividend
summary: OMAHA, Neb., November 16, 2026--Werner Enterprises, Inc. (Nasdaq: WERN), one of the nation’s largest transportation and logistics companies, announced today that its Board of Directors declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.14 (fourteen cents) per common share. This dividend will be paid on January 20, 2027, to stockholders of record at the close of business on January 4, 2027.

title: Werner® Chairman and CEO Derek Leathers Elected Chairman of the American Trucking Associations
summary: OMAHA, Neb., October 29, 2026--Werner Enterprises, Inc. (Nasdaq: WERN), a premier transportation and logistics provider, is proud to celebrate the election of its Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, Derek J. Leathers, as Chairman of the Board of the American Trucking Associations (ATA). Leathers was elected during the ATA Management Conference & Exhibition and will serve a one-year term spanning October 2026 through October 2027.
